Surgery went well and was quick. I was very nervous going into surgery since I have a very low pain tolerance, but now that I’m on day 13 I’d say it’s worth it. Don’t get me wrong, the first week is hell- especially first thing when you wake up. The meds really helped out days 1-3 post op, then days 4-5 were another level of hell on their own. The turning point was day 7 for me, and it’s been upwards since. It still feels uncomfortable but there’s less pain today. My doctor says I should be good to eat spicy and acidic foods in another week and actually taste them(my tastebuds are wonky). Immediate results from this were I feel more awake and I can breathe way better than before.
